userBrief.verbatim: faça uma landing page para um restaurante de culinária "pan-amazônica" chamado DaSelva. O prato principal é a banda de tambaqui e então precisa ter algum destaque. O conteúdo principal precisa ser extraido do documento anexo e adequado a uma boa medida de comprimento de scroll, ou seja, dosar o conteúdo extraindo o que importa para uma landing page. O site deve seguir as cores verde, offwhite e terracota.

authority.conflictRule: Target truth always wins. A reference may influence composition or behavior, but it may not add, negate, or rewrite DaSelva facts, claims, identity, offers, locations, proof, or commercial mechanics.

palette.usageRule: Deep green and off-white own the large fields; terracotta is an accent for action, heat, and editorial punctuation. No strategy may replace this target palette with a reference palette.

publicationMode.rule: Use ‘a Banda’ or descriptive ‘banda de tambaqui’. Do not publish ‘Banda de Tambaqui DaSelva’ as a protected product name until the INPI condition is resolved.

assetsAtFreeze.policy: No visual asset was supplied in Gate A. Before any strategy build, Gate C must freeze one shared target-media pack and hash it. The same pack must be available to all strategies. Reference assets may not stand in for DaSelva assets.

scrollEnvelope.rule: The envelope is a content-capacity guard, not a demand for blank space or artificially stretched motion. A strategy may exceed it only when a documented pinned or scrubbed scene adds meaningful information and remains coherent on mobile.

homeArc.purpose: Position the category, São Paulo presence, and reservation action immediately.

requiredCopy.headline: A mesa amazônica de São Paulo.
requiredCopy.support: Culinária pan-amazônica em duas casas — Centro e Vila Nova Conceição. Do tucupi ao jambu, do tambaqui à castanha: a Dieta Amazônica servida para partilhar.

homeArc.adaptation: Line breaks and microcopy may adapt to geometry; meaning, locations, category, and CTA intent may not change.

homeArc.purpose: Make the banda de tambaqui the unmistakable protagonist and explain its shared-table ritual.

requiredCopy.headline: Tem mesa que é de pizza. Tem mesa que é de churrasco. Esta é a mesa da banda.
requiredCopy.core: A metade do tambaqui, assada inteira e servida aberta no centro da mesa. Todo mundo serve todo mundo. O almoço de fim de semana que Manaus pratica há gerações chegou à sua mesa.
requiredCopy.ritual: Fim de semana, no Centro. Inteira, a banda vem no fim de semana; durante a semana, seus derivados atravessam o cardápio.
requiredCopy.CTA: Reservar para o fim de semana

homeArc.adaptation: The home keeps the ritual concise. Detailed fish, cut, season, and search-intent content belongs on /banda-de-tambaqui. Do not say ‘sem espinhas’.

homeArc.purpose: Explain the restaurant’s larger point of view without reproducing the full manifesto.

requiredCopy.headline: O sistema alimentar global é uma máquina de entropia. Nós somos sintropia.
requiredCopy.core: A DaSelva chama de Dieta Amazônica a cozinha de um bioma inteiro: peixes que exigem a floresta em pé, frutos que só existem onde há mata e técnicas que atravessaram gerações.
requiredCopy.close: Da comunidade ao prato. Cada passo verificado.

homeArc.adaptation: Keep one compact explanatory paragraph. Do not use ‘laboratório’, ‘alquimia’, unsupported health superlatives, or sustainability shorthand.

homeArc.purpose: Create appetite and show breadth without reproducing a full menu that was not supplied.

requiredCopy.headline: Da floresta, com nome e caminho.
requiredCopy.core: Pratos que traduzem o bioma — tacacá, moqueca, pirarucu de casaca e os derivados da banda — com origem identificada e estação respeitada. O cardápio muda com o rio, não contra ele.

homeArc.adaptation: Do not invent dish descriptions, prices, availability, or a complete menu. Scientific names may appear only if verified from the source package before Gate C.

homeArc.purpose: Support trust with traceability language already present in the source.

requiredCopy.headline: 2.800 km. E a gente sabe o nome de quem começou a viagem.
requiredCopy.core: Cada banda servida aqui é um peixe individual, com origem identificada: comunidade, produtor, jornada e cadeia de frio. Duas origens, dois caminhos, um padrão: a floresta em pé.

homeArc.adaptation: Do not name Tamanicuá without confirmed authorization. Do not introduce QR codes, audit systems, technical equipment, or unverified logistics detail.

homeArc.purpose: Convert interest into a clear choice of house and reservation intent.

rules: Freeze and hash the shared pack before the first strategy-specific build call.
Use identical original media files for S, C, and W; crop and composition may differ and must be disclosed.
No source-reference asset may be copied into the target media pack.
No image may imply a named community, award, celebrity, exact venue, or operational fact not supplied by the authority sources.

strategies.name: single-reference transformation control
strategies.contract: One observed reference may supply documented composition and interaction logic; all target semantics, identity, copy, palette, media, routes, and business behavior remain DaSelva-owned.

strategies.name: contextual chassis/donor
strategies.contract: One contextual chassis owns page spine, global grid, scroll authority, primary motion and responsive structure. Donors are bounded to named compatible dimensions and may not compete for global ownership.

strategies.name: static-first motion-aware scene synthesis
strategies.contract: Create a unified shared grammar, full-page desktop/mobile composition boards and a temporal storyboard before implementation. Re-author patterns into one layout and motion system.

requiredRetrievalCapabilities: content capacity for seven home movements
requiredFrozenEvidencePerReference: motion or interaction evidence when claimed
copycatProtection: No source brand, copy, identifying media, logo, product name, address, or commercial proof may enter an output.
Every preserved subsystem needs a PRESERVE, ADAPT, or REPLACE decision before implementation.
Direct source code or localized runtime assets must be disclosed and separately permitted.
If the target content cannot fit without essential loss or invented proof, stop for a divergence decision.

equalConditions.sharedInput: This exact manifest plus the later frozen reference bundle and shared target-media pack
perStrategyCallEnvelope: up to 4 bounded repair or polish calls

costCeiling.creditValue: 1 credit = USD 0.01 according to the current repository billing contract
costCeiling.derivation: Per strategy: compose 75 + reconstruct 200 + up to four edit calls at 50 each. Shared media: up to six Gemini image generations at 20 credits each.
costCeiling.rule: This is a hard ceiling, not approval to spend. Gate C requires a separate confirmation and actual cost must be recorded per call.

base: local fonts with documented license or system fallbacks
motion: Lenis only when it does not replace native accessibility behavior
allowedRuntime.conditionalRule: Video, WebGL or canvas requires exact reference evidence, a performance reason, mobile compensation, reduced-motion handling and a no-video/no-WebGL fallback.

forbiddenShared: repair advice derived from another strategy output

rules: Confirm listener ownership and served title before using a port.
No strategy output may be copied forward as the starting point for another.

qualityRubric.scoringScale: Each dimension is scored 1–5 with written evidence, then normalized to its percentage weight.

qualityFloor.rule: A hard-validity failure is disqualifying regardless of weighted score. Originality cannot rescue a result below the quality floor.

tieBreak: lower copycat risk and greater conscious transformation

requiredEvidencePerStrategy: desktop and mobile full-scroll recording when motion is material
navigation, hover, pin, scrub, video or WebGL interaction checks as applicable
network, console, broken-image and overflow report
qaProtocol.comparisonRule: Do not tune one strategy after seeing another without freezing and labeling a new comparison round for all affected strategies.

the shared media pack is absent or not identically available to all strategies

the coding model or reasoning level cannot be held equal

onStrategyFailure: preserve its last runnable state, logs, costs and partial evidence
do not donate its remaining budget to another strategy

rollback: All generated work stays outside the product worktree in the frozen output root.
A failed output may be archived by renaming its strategy directory with a round and failure suffix; do not delete evidence.
No shared database or production rollback is expected because those writes are forbidden.
Remove or deploy nothing without separate approval.

gateTransitions.gateAExit: This manifest parses, validates, and has a stable external SHA-256 lock.
gateTransitions.gateBRequires: Separate explicit approval for read-only retrieval, reference selection and bounded evidence capture.
gateTransitions.gateCRequires: Approved manifest hash, frozen reference bundles, frozen target-media-pack hash, approved 1545-credit ceiling and the exact confirmation token from manifest.lock.json.
gateTransitions.gateDRequires: Three preserved runnable outputs or an explicitly recorded failed/inconclusive Gate C result.
gateTransitions.gateERequires: Evidence-backed comparison complete; no production direction is inferred automatically.
